_readme: Single source of truth for the Oct 10 page, flyers, share card, .ics and JSON-LD. Edit facts here, never in HTML.
name: Political Education Party
tagline: Free. All ages. Bring your people.
purpose: A day in the park to learn about political prisoners and what their families carry — and to leave with a way to help, whether it's your own loved one inside or someone the movement is holding up.

venue.name: Fahim J. Minkah Park
venue.mapsQuery: Fahim J. Minkah Park, Dallas, TX 75241

program.title: Fahim J. Minkah and the original Black Panther Party of Dallas
Jail support, and the letter-writing table
Stations open — crafts, reading, letters, free groceries & clothes
Karmelo — and how you can stand with him
The Prairieland defendants — how to support
Fighting for our own liberation
program.who: Haki Shakur · New Afrikan Freedom Campaign

tables.what: His story, what you can do right now, and the sign-up sheet.
His family's call to action, and sign-ups for City Hall meetings.
His story, kept by the people who carry it.
Kids' arts & crafts, face painting, and free children's books.
Mutual aid — free groceries and clothes. Pick up a brochure, join the work.
Meet the political prisoners the movement holds up — then write to them at the letter station.
How jail support works, and how to give to bail and legal funds.
Nonpartisan. Check your registration; early voting runs Oct 19–30.
The freedmen's settlement in southeast Dallas County — its history and what it needs now.

tournament.prize: Prizes for the winning team in every bracket

bring.note: New or like-new, all reading levels

comfort: For you: a blanket or lawn chair, water, and sunscreen.

volunteer.what: Take a stack to your church, barbershop, salon or corner store.
Basketballs, books, craft supplies, groceries, blankets.
Greet people, hand out the program, point to the QR.
Crafts, reading and face painting with Malcolm X Academy.
Marshals, water station, first aid (certified only).
Leave the park better than we found it.

case.name: Karmelo Anthony
lines: A new trial was denied Aug 22 in a half-page order with no explanation. The 35-year sentence stands.
His appeal is live before the Fifth District Court of Appeals in Dallas. No argument date has been set.

posture: All actions are lawful, nonviolent, accessible, and locally compliant.
shareText: Political Education Party — Sat Oct 10, 10 AM–2 PM at Fahim J. Minkah Park in Dallas. Free food, books, a youth 3-on-3, and the people fighting for our loved ones inside.

captions.label: Announcement post
captions.text: Saturday, October 10 — Political Education Party at Fahim J. Minkah Park (formerly College Park), Dallas. 10 AM–2 PM. Free groceries and clothes, children's books, face painting, a youth 3-on-3 tournament, letter writing to political prisoners, and Chairman Fred Hampton Jr. on the fight for Karmelo. Free. All ages. RSVP: freekarmelo.net/oct10 #FreeKarmelo #FreeThemAll

captions.label: Youth 3-on-3
captions.text: Got a team of three? Youth 3-on-3 at the Political Education Party — ages 8–10, 11–13 and 14–16. Saturday Oct 10 at Fahim J. Minkah Park, Dallas. A parent or guardian registers each team: freekarmelo.net/oct10 #FreeKarmelo

captions.label: Bring a bag
captions.text: Coming Oct 10? Bring a bag: non-perishable groceries, clean clothes, children's books, craft supplies. It all goes back out to the neighborhood the same day. freekarmelo.net/oct10 #FreeThemAll

Details and RSVP: freekarmelo.net/oct10
